per_round:
Currency rounding was investigated and expanded in `tests/test_currency_rounding.py`. The implementation in `billing/currency.py` uses Decimal quantization with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. New tests cover half-cent cases, zero/small values, omitted `places`, high precision, scales 0–5, mixed input types, and the `places=-1` error path. All six focused tests pass with 91% coverage for `billing.currency`; Ruff passes. The full suite finished with 184 passed, 2 skipped, and no failures. An earlier legacy invoice-rounding failure was confirmed unrelated and left unchanged.

The primary session goal—splitting monolithic `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers—has not yet been started.

For the ordered GitHub Actions migration, only step 1 is complete: the working tree was checked and `.travis.yml` exists. Steps 2–9 remain pending: create/push `gha/test-workflow`, add and validate the workflow, commit it, then disable Travis only after success. Any tax-related changelog entries must include the Jira key in parentheses and be tagged `tax-doc` and assigned to `@marco`. For future test reporting, paste exact output rather than paraphrasing.
